title: Elgato Key Light Session Weekly On Time Trend
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=elgato:keylight on_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(on_minutes) as avg_duration, max(on_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst on time for Elgato Key Light session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture on_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average on time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Elgato Key Light session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
